Invalidate current-boot qualification on reboot or any new storage error
Do not claim performance from the G2 recovery canary
accepted_claim_level: Strong master-thesis system innovation with a CCF-C-style mechanism, online multifidelity search, full-graph and deployment evidence chain. P7R452 through P7R460 provide a three-by-three Y10 system-flow comparison from common T0 to deployable full-graph T1, reducing median wall from 696.427 to 244.844 seconds with only 0.285 percent final graph latency difference. P7R462 through P7R468 separately hold the 12-point candidate universe, budget and full-graph execution path constant: DMA prior reaches the exact oracle in three dispatches for all seeds versus four, six and six for mode-aware XGB, reducing median exact time-to-quality by 46.43 percent. Both methods reach oracle plus two percent on dispatch one and full-budget terminal wall is not reduced. P7R469/P7R470 add implementation-complete, label-isolated protocols for HW-Aware, ML2Tuner and Cheng baselines plus three ResNet18 candidate domains, but no target performance evidence yet. Because Y10 was already exposed, its same-space result is attribution rather than prospective validation; the frozen ResNet18 study remains the required cross-network evidence.
accepted_claim_level_update_p7r398: R50G adds a second prospective cheap-proxy-style workload and the first prospective execution of the frozen invalid-dominator-peeling stop rule. Its one-point wave reaches the five-point FPGA-correct pool oracle plus 2 percent with 0.714 percent paired-ratio regret, while reducing candidate builds and dispatches by 80 percent and model-build phase wall by 68.60 percent. It does not retain the exact oracle and no invalid front point occurred, so peeling fallback remains unvalidated. Board complete-outer-process wall was not serialized in P7R395/P7R397 and cannot be claimed. R50G uses source-consistent relay.testing.resnet with deterministic random parameters, so this is schedule-equivalence and relative-latency evidence rather than pretrained ImageNet accuracy.
accepted_claim_level_update_p7r408: R50H is the first prospective online validation of invalid-dominator peeling itself. A lowest-byte weight barrier passes lowering and three-seed FSim but fails whole-graph FPGA correctness on seed two; removing it exposes a sole wave-one candidate that is the complete correct-pool exact oracle. The online process dispatches four of fifteen candidates in 312.942 seconds outer wall. Relative to exhaustive measured components, dispatch/build action/FPGA invocation/logical DMA bytes fall 73.33/76.12/77.46/78.43 percent. Frozen bytes-lazy still reaches exact oracle in two dispatches, so the accepted contribution is fail-closed adaptive recovery, not uniform baseline superiority. The workload is one source-consistent Relay-testing ResNet50 layer on one boot without ImageNet accuracy or physical AXI counters.
accepted_claim_level_update_p7r419: R50I is the second source-consistent prospective online holdout under the unchanged peeling policy. Both initial-front points pass, so the run stops without expansion; the second point is the four-correct-point complete-pool exact oracle. It uses 2 of 5 dispatches in 213.527 seconds outer wall and reduces measured build action and logical DMA bytes by 63.41 and 52.22 percent versus exhaustive components. Calls-lazy reaches exact in one dispatch, so no universal superiority is claimed. Aggregating R50G/R50H/R50I gives 25 candidates, 23 correct, seven online dispatches, 3 of 3 oracle-plus-2-percent and 2 of 3 exact, but only R50H contains and removes a natural invalid dominator.
accepted_claim_level_update_p7r424: R50I's three simple controls are no longer cost replays only. P7R420 through P7R422 independently execute the pre-frozen two-candidate calls, bytes and random prefixes through model preparation, stock/candidate builds, clean-start FPGA correctness and timing. Calls and peeling both hit exact oracle, but calls first hits at 146.179 seconds versus peeling at 213.311 seconds; bytes and random do not reach the pool-oracle plus 2 percent band. Random's 199.165-second total is not a quality-adjusted win because its second candidate fails FPGA correctness and skips fourteen timing invocations. These post-pool executions strengthen cost accounting without becoming new prospective quality holdouts.
accepted_claim_level_update_p7r443: Y10 closes the prior cross-model and independently executed control gap. A source-hash-bound YOLOv3-tiny-320 conv18 pool was frozen before target labels; 12 of 12 candidates pass three-seed FPGA correctness across all eight graph outputs. Peeling reaches the exact oracle in 3 of 12 dispatches and 212.727 seconds, reducing exhaustive measured build, FPGA invocation and logical DMA components by about 75 to 76 percent. Calls-lazy and the one frozen Random seed reach exact on their first dispatch, while peeling and bytes require three, so the result supports a reliable low-candidate cross-model workflow but explicitly rejects universal Pareto/peeling superiority. Y09 is retained as a local lowering/FSim legality boundary and P7R433 as a board-preflight infrastructure failure with no label exposure.
accepted_claim_level_update_p7r444: The current selected Y10 completed-pool oracle now has an exact full-graph command-capacity certificate. Three deterministic 320x320 inputs produce 36 submissions with maximum instruction/UOP use of 1,065,280/1,320 bytes. A page-aligned 1,069,056+4,096-byte allocation reproduces all eight outputs exactly for all three inputs and reduces default 64 MiB command backing by 98.4009 percent. Removing one instruction page allows five prior submissions and rejects the violating command before device submission; the default runtime and one full-graph health inference are then restored. This graph-specific result closes the required deployment fail-closed experiment but is not a universal VTA capacity, physical AXI, dynamic-shape, accuracy, or FPS claim.
accepted_claim_level_update_p7r460: Three empty-history AutoTVM-XGB seeds and three deterministic proposed-method clean-start sessions now share a complete T0-to-T1 boundary. Median wall is 696.427 versus 244.844 seconds, a 64.84 percent reduction; the proposed method produces a fully verified graph within XGB final quality plus 2 percent at 120.279 seconds. Final graph medians are 1054.773 versus 1057.774 ms, only 0.285 percent apart; all six sessions pass three inputs across eight outputs and win seven of seven against their paired stock. Candidate-program dispatch falls from 115 to 3, but complete-graph safety checking makes proposed-method logical DMA higher. Stock XGBTuner uses a custom three-seed per-candidate clean-start runner because the unisolated P7R447 path is not completion-safe. This is a Y10 system-flow case study, not same-space algorithm attribution, a new holdout, physical AXI, or accuracy evidence.
accepted_claim_level_update_p7r468: The same-space selection attribution gap on exposed Y10 is closed. Across three seeds per policy with an identical 12-point tile-by-mode pool, six-candidate budget and complete-graph execution path, DMA prior reaches the exact oracle at dispatch three every time while mode-aware XGB reaches it at dispatch four, six and six. Median exact time-to-quality is 212.564 versus 396.797 seconds, a 46.43 percent reduction. Both policies reach oracle plus two percent at dispatch one, and full-budget terminal wall is effectively equal, so the result supports exact-oracle ordering on this pool rather than an early plus-two-percent or total-cost claim. It is an independent cost reexecution after labels existed, not a prospective or cross-network validation.
accepted_claim_level_update_p7r470: Node B implements and freezes the six-policy literature-aligned interface. HW-Aware has four initialization levels with E0 25+25 and min(1000, |S|) presampling; ML2Tuner separates P/V/A with N=10 and alpha=1 plus A+DMA; Cheng has four explicit schemes including a new functional combined input-prioritized/full-weight-resident barrier mode with not-applicable fallback. Three historical configurations pass all nine combined-mode FSim checks. Exact ResNet18 original ConfigSpaces are 2304/1600/480 rather than the assumed 1280; 24 label-blind max-min tiles per geometry expand to 288 preregistered identities. This is local method and protocol evidence only, not target lowering, FPGA or performance evidence.
